notes.title: V1.3.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes:

 Fixed Perseus field achievements not triggering.
 Fixed the auto repair component showing a technician job anchor instead of maintenance.
 Fixed some errors generating lots of logs when using the auto repair component and removing damaged tiles.
 Fixed a placement bug where the weapon station would flash in the bottom left corner and get assigned to the tile before being placed. This would result in the bottom left corner being blocked for no apparent reason.
 Fixed a small display issue for the ground build tab which was showing 3 out of 4 unlocked.
 Fixed missing text in Perseus Fields when selecting the Alliance for the final act.
 Fixed Outsiders getting triggered 1 year too early on Perseus Fields.
 Fixed upgrade icons for Flos Caeruleus.


Balance:

 Changed the Rail gun burst chance upgrade from 50% to 30%.

notes.title: V1.3 Space eggs
notes.content:
V1.3

Features:

 New Component Auto-repair module.
 New late game event Unknown Eggs.
 2 perks for the Auto-repair module.
 Added a new perk for the life support system.
 Added upgrade tree for Reactor component.
 Added Rare perk tree with 5 perks in it:

 Stop Common perks from being offered.
 Stop Rare perks from being offered.
 Stop Unique perks from being offered.  (New unlocks are excluded)
 +1 Bounce all projectiles.
 +1 AOE all projectiles.

 Added a special perk for Wave generator, Missile Silo, Rail Gun & Flos Caeruleus weapons.
 Added synergies for Wave generator,  Missile Silo, Rail Gun & Flos Caeruleus weapon.
 Added upgrade tree for Wave generator, Missile Silo, Rail Gun & Flos Caeruleus weapons.


Balance:

 Reactor health lowered from 300 to 150.
 Reactor is now part of the Captaining upgrade tree.


Fixes:

 Fixed Catsie not reviving quickly when playing a custom game.
 Fixed an issue where some ships could have more health than the sum of all tiles and components on board.
 Fixed a bug where ship components would stop working after an assigned crew died, revived and then replaced a newly assigned crew.
 Fixed a bug with Unity when reloading a saved game. Synergies were not being applied correctly on load.
 Fixed auto pan setting not saving correctly.
 Fixed some tech weapon not being affected correctly by some perks.
 Fixed a placement bug with larger components placed in space after reloading a saved game allowing to build on top of them.


Small changes:

 Fixed a small localization issue with the local lab event.
 Added skip button for game over screen.
 Larger fleet gadget now grant extra XP when defeating larger fleets.
 Added UI Tooltip of a crew’s stats in Mercenary mission selection, Crew management menu, Conscription event and Colony event.

notes.title: V1.2 Catsie
notes.content:
V1.2

Features:


 New weapon: Rail Gun. Kinetic weapon that fires high-damage extremely high-speed projectiles.
 New weapon: Missile Silo. Missile-based weapon that fires a slow-moving high-health missile that deals extremely high damage.
 New weapon: EMP Wave Generator. Tech weapon that creates an AOE wave disabling most components it hits.
 Added new manager Catsie. Ability: gains extra bounces on each projectile, but the number of weapons slots is reduced. Special status: quick reviver (Instantly revives at reborn stations. Takes priority over other staff reviving.)
 Added 5 new gadgets for unlocking special components. Reactor, Rail Gun, Missile Silo, Flos Caeruleus and EMP Wave Generator.


Balance:


 Missile launcher: missile health reduced from 2/8/20 to 2/6/12
 Breacher: missile health increased from 2/8/20 to 4/10/24
 Anti-missile gun: instant kill chance upgrades changed to 3X critical hit chance.
 Reduced enemy growth rate on Perseus Fields from 2 to 0.5
 Reduced cost for Breacher weapons from 4000 to 1500. Also reduced the cost of upgrades.
 Improved reload time of Breacher weapon from 20 to 16.
 Improved reload time of the Gamma-Ray from 30 to 25.


Fixes:


 Fixed an issue with characters not being able to be revived when dying inside the Medic Station.
 Fixed Quad Synergy achievement being acquired from an enemy ship fulfilling the requirements.
 Fixed a progression block when sending the station manager on a mercenary mission and subsequently defeating a mini boss.
 Fixed Machine Gun rate of fire special upgrade giving negative bonuses.
 Accuracy now displays correctly 100% when accuracy gadgets are enabled.
 Fixed behaviour bug with characters assigned to a room where they would wander outside to complete fire or repair tasks.
 Fixed an issue with character repairing while being assigned to stay at the component leading to the repair never ending.


Misc:


 Added rotation (Shortcut: R) for larger components.
 Added the ability to build an Air Lock while the station is on fire.
 Characters set to Go anywhere no longer try to find a task around the ship after reaching a destination set by the player. They will only be able to grab tasks inside the room they are in for 30 seconds. After the timer expires the normal behaviour is restored. This should avoid issues where a crew sent away from a room with no oxygen would immediately return for a task.
 Characters manually assigned to a component with either Stay in room or Go anywhere behaviour won’t be considered for a new task assignment for 30 seconds. This should make it easier to temporarily assign a crew to a component without changing their AI behaviour.
 Combat UI: added autofire toggle for control groups. On by default. Turning autofire off will hold firing while still reloading.
 Combat UI: replaced the last control group (0) with an All Weapon group. Selecting targets with this control group will assign all weapons to 1 target. Also allows group toggle autofire and auto-targeting.
 Added character work anchor for Reborn Station to allow assigning a technician to speed up the progress.
 Added settings to allow playing music while the application is minimized.

notes.title: V1.1 Extra Threat
notes.content:
Features:

 Added Blank manager.
 Added New Manager Unity. Ability: All synergies are doubled.
 Added the option to start with a blank layout. Provides an extra 5000 omni cash.
 New event: Optional bosses. Every 70 days or so a random boss will pass near the station. It can be engaged or left alone. If left alone the threat level will increase. There are 6 types available: Holo Ship, Factory Ship, Swarm, Pyro Ship, Carrier and Unmanned drone.
 New ship component: Fusion Reactor. Can be unlocked in a special event. Provide lots of power for only 1 tile in size but explodes when destroyed.
 New event: Mining collective. Increases income but creates a higher threat level increasing difficulty overtime.
 New event: Research station. Gain random perks overtime but creates a higher threat level increasing difficulty overtime.


Balance:

 Added bonus omnicash after defeating enemies. The reward is based on the size of the ships and their state at the end of combat.
 Capped evasion at 90%.
 Added an end game event boss that gets impossibly stronger to end the game at a reasonable time. It also allows the player to end with a victory. 
 Increased the cost of upgrades for the mining rig.
 Lowered the colony upgrade increase in revenue from +0.25 to +0.2 per levels.


Fixes:

 Fixed issue where unlocked managers could sometimes not save their newly unlocked state correctly.
 Fixed range bonuses on Anti Missile turret not being added correctly.
 Fixed bug when selling most of the floors tiles and falling below or at 0 HP.
 Fixed a visual bug when a crew died from both damage and oxygen at the same time.


Misc:

 Character AI now prioritizes hull breaches over repairs and component repair over tile repair.
 Made fast combat enabled the default. This was previously disabled and required enabling manually in the settings.
 Added hint in character menu for augmented crew.
 Rogue points gained on hard difficulty increased.
 Added settings option to disable auto pan when destroying enemy ships.
 Certain perks will stop being offered once maxed. (Accuracy, breach, fire starter, damage and oxygen reduction perks).
 Added a small sequence to show the manager’s XP Gain after combat.
 Improved game stability in later combat.

notes.title: V1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes:

 Fixed a weapon placement bug where placing the second part over the build menu would result in an unresponsive UI.
 Fixed an issue on some screen resolution that would cut part of the build menu UI.

notes.title: V1.0 Launch Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Rogue Station 1.0 is out! Thanks to everyone who helped during early access and provided feedback.

As a small thank you, I set up the early access depots separately so the soundtrack can be included for free in the coming days. This will only apply to anyone who purchased before the 22nd of August 2023.

What to expect in the future? 

Updates are planned for a long time after the release. This is something I very much enjoy working on and, now that the game is released, I can focus on content.
Feedback and suggestions are always welcome and will keep guiding priorities going forward.

Patch notes
Balance:

 Increased end game difficulty growth.


Fixes:

 Fixed control issue with the new UI blocking movement on the right when a character was selected.
 Fixed a bug with enemy scaling using perks. The added perks would have 0 default values and added no extra difficulty.
 Fixed custom game issue with year length not being taken into account.
 Fixed a bug with enemy ships not loading their correct floor health.
 Fixed a bug after loading a saved game where future ships might spawn pre-damaged.
 Fixed issue with crew count on loaded ships.
 Fixed AI behavior where crew kept going back to the first room they appeared in instead of roaming around when set to go anywhere.
 Fixed AI behavior for Stay At Component crew after getting reborn. If someone had taken their spot, they would not return correctly to their assigned station.
 Visual fixes when destroying ships.
 Fixed issue where, after removing a selected character, the UI could become unresponsive.


Misc:

 Localization for a few extra languages has been added as options in settings. These translations are not supported and are not very good but, since they were included by error when the OS language matched and to avoid anyone losing previous functionality, they will be available to use as is.

notes.title: V0.1.14.3 Localization
notes.content:
Features:

 New localization.


Balance:

 Increased slightly the number of crew available on enemy ships.


Fixes:

 Fixed issue with medic station’s access in corners.
 Fixed a bug with selection UI after selecting enemy crew.

notes.title: Upcoming launch on August 22nd!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Rogue Station is about to leave early access this coming 22nd of August! Thanks to everyone who helped during early access and provided feedback. This was a personal project I wanted to make for a long time and want to keep working on.

As a small thank you, I set up the early access depots separately so I can include the soundtrack (also releasing on the 22nd) for free. This will only apply to anyone who purchased before the 22nd of August 2023.

What does this full release mean for the game? 


 Updates are planned for a long time after the release. This is something I very much enjoy working on and, now that the game will be fully released, I will focus more on content.
 Feedback and suggestions are always welcome and will keep guiding priorities after release.
 The game’s price won’t change.


Best regards,
Leo

Patch notes
V0.1.14
Features:

 UI rework. Added an interactable preview of enemy ships.



Balance:

 Lowered the bonus ability levels on trader characters by 1.
 Colony event: Extortion now much more likely to succeed.
 Mercenary missions: Increased difficulty slightly.


Fixes:

notes.title: V0.1.13 Steam integration
notes.content:
Features:

 Added bionic surgeon event.
 Added steam achievements.
 Added cloud sync.

Balance:

 The Holo ship weapon reward is now free instead of costing 3000.
 Removed mercenary mission upgrades from the laser blaster and machine gun. The mercenary mission weapon gets upgraded based on the selected crew’s combat skill now.
 Added an early game event on the first map with a special reward on day 50.

Fixes:

 Fixed issues with the generator when getting disabled/enabled and not refreshing correctly.
 Fixed build issue with two-part component blocking placement after being removed.
 Fixed multiple visual bugs with moving targets and weapon hits.
 Fixed issue with larger component and fires not getting put out correctly.

notes.title: V0.1.12 Game Customization
notes.content:
Features:

 Added alpha version of the custom game.
 New unique event: Holo Ship.

Balance:

 Rework of how the enemy ship scales in difficulty. There should be less variance in difficulty between ships.
 Added armor stats for characters. 

 Soldiers start with 10% as a base.
 Crew gain +2% per level in combat. 3% if they have previous soldier experience and 4% for soldiers. 
 This is applied after the global crew damage reduction you get from perks.
 Examples: Pilot with 4 in combat 8%, Soldier with 3 in combat 22%.

 Increased cost of life support to 1000 (500 previously).
 Increased damage of Gamma Ray beam.
 Increased crew minimum health to 50 (20 previously).
 Reduced overall health of asteroids by roughly a third.
 Reduced energy consumption of breacher weapon by half.
 Increase Generator level 1-2 power output slightly. 
 Increased Generator purchase cost by 500.
 EMP weapon: Added bonus base damage against shields.
 Trader shop crew for hire cost reduced and stats increased.
 Buffed forcefield level 4 right upgrade from + 0.05 movement speed per day to +0.25.
 Tweaked the difficulty on Perseus Fields.
 Made the shield block and forcefield slow perk scale with the current day.

 Old Shield block perk was +20-300 solely based on rarity.
 New Shield block at day 0 = +10-150, day 500 = +110-1650
 Old forcefield slow was +1-8 slow per second.
 New forcefield slow at day 0 = +0.5 - 4, day 500 = +5.5 - 44 


Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where sometimes the rival combat could be cut short.
 Fixed some layout issues with the gameover recap screen.
 Fixed a bug with the burst laser special which would decrease the damage instead of increasing it.
 Fixed a but with the Generator receiving 3X production bonus when not staffed with the staff upgrade.
 Fixed bug with Colony not deducting money correctly when requesting a crew but none is available.
 Other minor bug fixes.

Misc:

 Reworked 30 ship layouts with new assets and better balance.
 Small improvement on AI task selection when giving orders. Previously characters would grab the job with the highest priority at the selected location without checking if another crew was already performing the task. Now They will first try and grab the highest priority task no one is currently assigned to and if none they will then grab the task from another character.
 Added evasion, ship armor and crew armor display to the enemy preview.
 Small visual improvement to Perseus Field map.
 Improved auto targeting for some weapons:

 Breacher now tries to auto target empty floor tiles first.
 EMP now tries to auto target ship components.
 Plasma and Gamma beams secondary beams target the same ship as the primary beam.
 Gamma beam tries to auto target staffed ship components.

notes.title: V0.1.11.1 Asteroid Fix

 Fixed visual bug when changing the layout while in low oxygen.
 Fixed power menu issues when selling components.

 Fixed issues with crew firefighting on larger components.


Misc:

notes.title: V0.10.2 Hotfix for DART weapon during boss battle
notes.content:
Fixes

 Fixed a progression block when entering boss combat with a DART weapon.

notes.title: V0.1.10.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes:

 Fixed issue when selling floor tiles. Assigned characters would get removed from their station.

notes.title: V0.1.10 Weapons!
notes.content:
Warning current saved game will be erased!

No progress will be lost. Only the current saved game will be cleared when loading the game in the new version due to save format issues.

Features:

 New weapon Breacher: Missile based weapon designed to create hull breaches.
 New weapon Dart system: Missile based weapon that fires multiple small rockets in an area.
 New weapon Plasma beam: Tech weapon that creates a beam of hot plasma igniting fires.
 New weapon EMP gun: Tech weapon that disables enemy systems.
 New weapon Gamma ray: Tech weapon that deals a high amount of damage to enemy crew.
 Perks trees: Perks now fall into separate buckets. When adding more perk into a specific one, that bucket will show up more often. A certain number of perks in a bucket is also required to unlock more advanced components and special upgrades.
 Rerolls can now only be used once per perk selection. Rerolls also keep the previous options.
 Small merchant rework. Can no longer rob. Merchant no longer scales based on previous purchases but on the current date and some RNG instead. The available perks at the shop are now only available at the shop. Crew from the shop are now a lot stronger.


Fixes:

 Fixed an issue when defeating the end of year boss with no active manager on board the station.
 Fixed characters not pathing to repair a component when targeting an area of the component that is blocked.
 Fixed character not being able to put out fires at the back of some larger components.
 Fixed bug where the game wouldn’t gameover out of combat when hull reached 0 due to a fire on board.
 Fixed a bug where characters would keep pathing through space when deleting tiles.
 Fixed issue when crew would all die outside of combat resulting in the game not ending in some scenarios.
 Building/selling now gets canceled when closing the build menu.
 Fixed a bug where character's abilities wouldn't get updated correctly after leveling.
 Fixed characters getting stuck when reborn stations are built with no room below.
 Fixed ship’s hull being unrepairable when selling damaged tiles or components. They now get fully healed before being sold.
 Fixed oxygen levels between 2 rooms bouncing back and forth when full.
 Fixed power down hint not appearing after reloading a game.
 Fixed issue when reloading a game with the crew set to stay at work station going idle right away.
 Fixed an issue with crew marked as stay at component not returning to their components after getting reborned.
 Fixed an issue in the upgrade menu that was blocking the pause/resume shortcut from working.
 Fixed a bug where characters would get duplicated when returning from missions.
 Fixed a bug where starting the final boss wouldn’t reset the game speed before combat.
 Fixed resource nodes moving during combat resulting in lost mining time.
 Fixed boss fight not scaling correctly with difficulty modifiers.
 Fixed bug with disabled life support not refreshing oxygen production correctly.
 Fixed a bug with some fleets where 1 of the ships might also get destroyed along an other one so seemingly no reason.
 Fixed a bug where components could get assigned to a character that’s not currently using it resulting in the component being locked for other characters to use.
 Fixed a bug with some missile weapon upgrades not applying correctly.


Balance:

 Reworked the upgrades for all components to be only 5 levels instead of 9.
 Missile weapon station: Reduced purchase and upgrade cost, reduced damage and AOE scaling.
 Swap the carry capacity upgrade for mining rig with the movement speed upgrade. This was making the station worse earlier on.
 Colony events now always accept money if no specific crew is present but the amount is larger in that case.
 Reworked all 4 manager’s loadout slightly. They each have 1 different weapon type unlocked at the start.



Misc:

 New music track
 Added hint for currently selected upgrade in the upgrade menu. Also when changing categories, the first available element will get selected now.
 Newest applicant in the hire list now appears at the top.
 Selected ship components now show Off instead of standby if turned off while in standby mode.
 Added toggle for tooltips in settings menu.
 Added visuals for a selected crew’s pathing.
 Managers now receive a Health, Movement Speed and Max Oxygen bonus when gaining a level.

notes.title: V0.1.9 New ships and bug fixes.

V0.1.9

Fixes:

Misc:

notes.title: V0.1.8 Perseus Fields
notes.content:
V0.1.8
Features:

 New map(alpha): Perseus Fields, some of the events and difficulty still needs to be tweaked.
 New perk: Ship damage reduction. Reduces all incoming damage by X%.


Fixes:

 Fixed a small issue with in game saved keys being carried over between games.
 Fixed mining rigs blocking the path went they shouldn’t. The area where characters stand should allow pathing.
 Fixed issue with the final boss sequence not playing correctly.
 Fixed issue with doors. When destroyed they received an AIR LEAK instead of removing their AIR SEAL causing oxygen loss in the ship instead of letting the air flow through as intended.
 

Balance:

 Artillery now only requires 2 crew to fire. The reload time is still based on 4 crew being present so 2 crew will only reload half as fast.
 Character movement speed range changed from (0.7 - 4) to (1.5 - 3.5).
 Character movement speed penalty for injuries now capped at 75%.

Misc:


 Improved positioning of the walls to allow all components to fit inside the layout.
 Added the number of weapons on enemy ships to the enemy UI.

notes.title: V0.1.7 Gadgets!
notes.content:
V0.1.7
Features:

 NEW gadget system was added. 25 initial gadgets to unlock with Rogue Points. They fall into 3 broad categories: improvements for the player, increase in difficulty and gameplay modifier (the last one doesn’t necessarily increase or reduce the difficulty).
 Managers now cost Rogue Points to unlock instead of simply being unlocked once the amount is acquired.
 Added upgrade tree for missile launcher.
 Added upgrade tree for life support.
 Added upgrade tree for medic station.
 Added upgrade tree for piloting station.
 Added upgrade tree for mining station.


Fixes:

 Fixed power and oxygen not updating their staffed bonuses correctly when assigning and removing characters.
 Fixed issue with the artillery special perks that caused the reload time to be many times longer.
 Fixed issue where assigned characters in some circumstances would lose their task, but would keep blocking new assignments on the component they are assigned to. Characters would simply shake back and forth trying to get assigned to the task.
 

Balance:

 Mostly disabled the ship component destroyed mechanic (when a component’s health reaches 0, it gets destroyed and requires a certain amount of repair before health can be replenished). The repair amount is now 1% of HP.
 Air locks and doors now let air through when destroyed.
 Tweaked the starting layouts a bit to reduce starting difficulty.


Misc:

 Added a small hint when pathing is impossible for a character.
 Added alive crew count hint on crew management UI button.
 Added crew’s job badge in crew management UI.
 Ship destruction animation now plays at scaled time.
 Some small visual improvements.
 Game now autosaves after each battle.

V0.1.6

 Added upgrade tree for force fields.

notes.title: V0.1.5 Balance and bugs.
notes.content:
V0.1.5
Features:

 Added upgrade tree for shield.
 Added upgrade tree for Laser blaster.
 Added upgrade tree for Machine gun.

Fixes:

[olist]
 Fixed more Nullref with projectiles during a ship’s destruction.
 Fixed issue when renaming characters in game.
 Fixed issue when renaming character on the new game screen.
 Fixed laser with AOE only dealing 1 tile worth of damage to shields. They now deal their full AOE’s worth. 
 Fixed small localization bugs.
 Fixed issue with tasks being created by error when reloading saved games.
 Fixed accrued rerolls not being saved correctly.
 Fixed many small display issues.
 Fixed a bug when re-rolling perks more than once.
[/olist]
Balance:

 Small increase to tile’s health. Enemy ships now should always have enough health in their tiles to get destroyed properly.
 Enemy ship defense scaling improved. They now have shield, force and anti missile upgrades based on their difficulty as a base.
 Reduced instant kill perks percentages.
 Increased Shield and Force Field strength. 
 Colony improvements are more expensive.

Misc:

 Added enemy shield display status on their UI nodes.
 Added more information about the enemy ships. They now display the number of crew, upgrades & perks they have. This should help at a glance know how dangerous a ship is.
 REMOVED 2X and 8X speeds from battles (There is now an option in the settings menu to turn this on but the default setting is OFF). An issue I have noticed when watching people play is because there is the ability to fast forward during battles people will use it. That often leads to early loses as things can get out of control fairly quickly and overall makes the game much less balanced. You get upgrades, feel strong, obliterate a few enemies and all of a sudden you lose because a critical piece got damaged and wasn't prioritized in time. 
 Added a visual hint when components get disabled.

notes.title: V0.1.4b Hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix

Fixed stack overflow issue with lingering bombs.

notes.title: V0.1.4 Hotfix and balancing
notes.content:
V0.1.4
Features:

 Added rerolls to perk selection. You now start with 1 reroll and accrue 1 every 50 days.


Fixes:

 Fixed NullRef issues in pathfinder, Anti missile turret & lingering bombs.
 Fixed mobile station being out of the screen limits when spawning.
 Fixed boundary issues on very large resolutions.
 Fixed mercenary missions possibly stacking incorrectly causing a progression block.
 Fixed pause overlay being shown in combat and vice versa for combat.
 Fixed an annoying bug with the shield where it keeps turning off at 50% instead of 0.
 Fixed progression block when components got upgraded past their max level by error. This would also happen in later stages of the game for the enemy ships.
 Fixed enemy characters spawning in random locations instead of their current task. When an enemy ship appears, all crew will be in position ready to fight.
 Fixed an issue with the in game menu being open at the same time as other events, resuming the game while playing the events(such as the mercenary mission).

Misc:

 Added tooltips to the upcoming UI elements.


Balance:

Events:

 Colony can now grow up to 10 levels (previously 5) with the cost of upgrading increasing faster than before. Once fully leveled the event then provides a large cash reward (end game).
 Mercenary missions now go up to lvl 10 (previously 5) with better reward. When playing the mission, your weapon will be a modified version of either the laser blaster or machine gun depending on which is higher level. At lvl 3 the weapon will not fire 2 projectiles and from lvl 6 2 additional ones in a slight V shape (In the next path this will be included in their upgrade tree).

	
Characters:

 Reduced job bonus from 400% to 200%.
 Reduced previous job bonus from 200% to 150%.




Ship:

 Upgrade system rework: Upgrades are now in their own menu accessible either via the main screen or via a button when selecting a component.
 The new system has a small upgrade tree with different paths giving out different bonuses [INCOMPLETE]. For this update only the generator has actual path decisions, other systems will be shortly added but I didn’t want to delay the patch too much as ~20 systems X 6 special upgrades equals 120 modifiers with localization etc.
 Weapons balance: All weapons have been rebalanced (still Work in progress). First tier of weapons don’t scale to very high dps anymore and are more useful for their utility upgrades later on. 
 Increased health to keep up with DPS better. Floor tiles also have more health and give bigger health bonuses when upgraded.

Oxygen:


 Air leaks are now 5X larger than before. The max air loss for a breach is now 1000(up from 200) units or 50% of an open door flow.

Fire:

 Fire ignition of nearby tiles increased to 0.2 (previously 0.1). That means if a fire is burning with 20 fire ranks, nearby tiles will get +4 ignition ranks per seconds (100 require to ignite).

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.1
notes.content:
V0.1.3.1
Features:
Fixes:

 Fixed in game menu resizing incorrectly on super wide screens.
 Fixed progression block with 2nd unlocked character starting out with no weapons.

Misc:

 Added resolution options.
 Merged the main menu and in game setting views.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
V0.1.3
Features:

 Added WASD/Arrow movement in game.

Fixes:

 Fixed prog block when losing at the same time as an event is triggered.
 Fixed SFX overlap in mercenary missions.
 Fixed bug where life support getting damage on enemy ship was not cutting off oxygen.
 Fixed issue with tasks not being assigned correctly when assigning characters to larger components.
 Fixed issue where Rank perks are being offered for locked components.
 Fixed FTUX issue where the center enemy shortcut no longer works after the last tip.


Misc:

 Renamed the delete button to sell.
 Added visual help for power cost before building components.
 Reworked power UI display on the status bar.


Balance:
Characters:

 Greatly increase character skill level up speed.

Systems:

 Shields: Increased damage block.
 Shields: Reduced replenish per seconds gain when upgrading.
 Shields: Increased upgrade costs.
 Life Support: Change the system’s Operation Ratio from being linear to ease in expo. In short the system loses most of its effectiveness after only a small amount of damage (opposite of the generator). The goal is to make it easier to suffocate a ship and add more importance to life support/Oxygen management in general.

Weapons:

 Artillery: Reduced upgrade cost/time.
 Artillery: Increased accuracy a lot.
 Machine Gun: Increased fire rate.
 Buffed 2 Artillery perks.
